_comment: Chapter manifest (ADR-0007). Titles and blurbs live here so the select screen costs one small fetch rather than four scenario files — learners pay per megabyte (AGENTS.md section 3). Chapters are never locked: order is a suggestion, not a gate (ADR-0005, D-008).

shift.en: Find a price. Win a customer.

blurb.en: Asha sells mandazi by the bus stand. Twenty weeks of decisions about price, cost, customers and time.
blurb.sw: Asha anauza mandazi karibu na kituo cha basi. Wiki ishirini za maamuzi kuhusu bei, gharama, wateja na muda.

bridge.en: You tried prices and customers at the stall. Now Asha has an oven and shop orders. Can you keep cash moving while customers pay later?
bridge.sw: Umejaribu bei na wateja kibandani. Sasa Asha ana oveni na oda za maduka. Unaweza kuendeleza mzunguko wa pesa wateja wanapolipa baadaye?

shift.en: An oven, a team, and bills to pay.
shift.sw: Oveni, timu, na bili za kulipa.

blurb.en: A premises, an oven and two shops that want to buy wholesale. Money now arrives on a different schedule from the work that earned it.
blurb.sw: Jengo, oveni na maduka mawili yanayotaka kununua kwa jumla. Sasa pesa inafika kwa ratiba tofauti na kazi iliyoiingiza.

bridge.en: The bakery needs more than good baking. In the factory, Asha must build a team that can make decisions without waiting for her.
bridge.sw: Biashara ya mkate inahitaji zaidi ya kuoka vizuri. Kiwandani, Asha lazima ajenge timu inayoweza kufanya maamuzi bila kumsubiri.

shift.en: You cannot do every job yourself.

blurb.en: A leased unit, staff, a van and a loan. Decisions stop being about what to do and start being about who decides.
blurb.sw: Jengo la kupanga, wafanyakazi, gari na mkopo. Maamuzi hayahusu tena nini cha kufanya, bali nani anaamua.

bridge.en: Asha’s next buyer is overseas. The order is bigger, but the journey is longer and payment may arrive much later.
bridge.sw: Mnunuzi anayefuata wa Asha yuko nje ya nchi. Oda ni kubwa, lakini safari ni ndefu na malipo yanaweza kuchelewa zaidi.

shift.en: New buyers. Longer waits for payment.
shift.sw: Wanunuzi wapya. Muda mrefu wa kusubiri malipo.

blurb.en: A buyer abroad, a currency you do not control, and ninety days between shipping and being paid.
blurb.sw: Mnunuzi nje ya nchi, sarafu usiyoidhibiti, na siku tisini kati ya kusafirisha na kulipwa.
